summary: Rising bonds yields and growing government debt could see interest rates start to rise
content:
World Service , · 04 Sep 2026 , · 24 mins

There has been a lot of talk about rising bond yields, from Japan to the UK and the US, and alongside this government debt is growing all around the world. That all plays into a feeling that many people have that life is about to get more expensive and that in many places interest rates are set to rise. Rahul Tandon is joined by David Kuo, co-founder of The Smart Investor in Singapore and German business journalist Ellen Frauenknecht. (Photo: Passersby stand before a stock market indicator board in Tokyo, Japan, 2 September, 2026. Tokyo stocks plunged as Japanese government bond yields rose to its highest level in 30 years and escalating attacks between the United States and Iran. Credit: Franck Robichon/EPA/Shutterstock) Presenter: Rahul Tandon Producer: Matt Lines
chineseSummary: 债券收益率上升和政府债务增加可能导致利率开始上升
chineseContent:
全球服务，·2026 年 9 月 4 日，·24 分钟

从日本到英国和美国，关于债券收益率上升的讨论很多，与此同时，世界各地的政府债务也在增长。这一切都让许多人感到生活将变得更加昂贵，而且许多地方的利率将会上升。新加坡 The Smart Investor 联合创始人 David Kuo 和德国商业记者 Ellen Frauenknecht 也加入了 Rahul Tandon 的行列。 （照片：2026 年 9 月 2 日，路人站在日本东京的股市指标板前。由于日本政府债券收益率升至 30 年来的最高水平以及美国和伊朗之间的攻击不断升级，东京股市暴跌。图片来源：Franck Robichon/EPA/Shutterstock） 演讲者：Rahul Tandon 制片人：Matt Lines
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
